text: RESULTS: Acetylcholine Receptor Antibody: Positive (Indicates the presence of autoantibodies to acetylcholine receptors, associated with myasthenia gravis); Electromyography and Nerve Conduction Studies: Decreased response with repetitive nerve stimulation, suggestive of a neuromuscular junction disorder; CT Scan Chest: No thymoma or other abnormalities. speaker: Doctor
text: The positive antibody test and confirmatory nerve studies, combined with your fluctuating weakness and diplopia, clearly point to Myasthenia Gravis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis
